name: lawlens-search
description: Search indexed Indian judgments and legislation and retrieve source excerpts.

interface.longDescription:
Search indexed Indian judgments and legislation for legal research. Find sources using keywords, phrases, word proximity, court and date filters, party and judge names, neutral citations, acts and provisions. Discover exact stored filter values and retrieve indexed text for selected results. Results include document IDs, available metadata and source links.

Designed for lawyers, law students and researchers. LawLens tools retrieve indexed sources; they do not generate AI legal answers, provide legal advice, or verify whether an authority remains good law. Retrieved text may be partial and is not guaranteed to be the complete original document. Consult the linked source and independently assess it before relying on the material.
defaultPrompt: Find Supreme Court judgments discussing anticipatory bail after January 1, 2024.
Find section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and show the indexed text.
Find judgments involving State of Maharashtra and show their source links.

review.commerce_description: This read-only integration searches public legal sources and retrieves indexed text. It does not offer purchases, payments, subscriptions, or checkout.

publication.release_notes: LawLens Search 1.0.2 adds the submission demo recording URL. Search indexed Indian judgments and legislation using keywords, phrases, court and date filters, party names, and act or provision references. Look up judgments by neutral citation, discover exact filter values, paginate results, and retrieve indexed source text with source links. This read-only integration does not require a LawLens account or payment. Retrieved text may be incomplete; the integration does not provide legal advice or verify whether an authority remains good law.
